chapterInfo.content:
7
Nnipa pa nnɔɔso
1Mennue, na mayɛ
sɛ nnuabateɛ,
sɛ bobe aba mpɛpɛdie,
bobe esia a mɛdie,
borɔdɔmakan a me kɔn dɔ no bi nni hɔ.
2 # Dwom 12.1 Nnipa pa ayera afiri asase so;
teefoɔ nni nnipa mu,
wɔn nyinaa tetɛ mogya,
wɔsunsum wɔn nuanom fidie.
3Wɔn nsa gu bɔne so sɛ ɛnyɛ yie;
ɔsafohene bisa biribi, na ɔtemmufoɔ pɛ kɛtɛasehyɛ,
na onipa kɛseɛ ka ne kra bɔnepɛ ho asɛm,
sɛdeɛ wɔbom nwono amumuyɛ ne no.
4Wɔn mu nipa pa te sɛ hwerɛmo,
wɔn mu teefoɔ sene nkasɛɛ ban.
W’awɛmfoɔ da no, w’asotwe no reba,
ɛno na wɔn sakasakayɛ bɛduro.
5Monnnye adamfoɔ nnni,
mommfa mo ho nnto ɔyɔnkoɔ so;
ɔbaa a ɔda wo koko mu no,
ne ho na wɛn w’ano.
6 # Yer 9.4-5; Mat 10.35-36 Na ɔbabanin bu n’agya ɔsesani,
ɔbabaa sɔre tia ne na,
aseɛ sɔre tia n’ase,
onipa fiefoɔ yɛ n’atamfo.
Anidasoɔ ne adesrɛ
7Na me deɛ, AWURADE na mehwɛ no kwan,
mɛtwɛn me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn no.
Me Nyankopɔn bɛtie me.
8 # Oba 12 Me tamfo, mma w’ani nnnye me ho;
na mahwe ase a, mɛsɔre;
na mete sum mu a,
AWURADE ne me hann.
9 # Yer 14.7 Mɛsoa AWURADE abufuhyeɛ no,
ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ no bɔne,
de akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛham me ham ama me,
na wabu atɛn ama me;
ɔbɛyi me afiri aba hann mu;
mɛhwɛ ne tenenee no.
10 # Dwom 79.10 Na me tamfo bɛhunu,
na aniwuo abɛkata ne so, ɔno a ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Ɛhe na wo Nyankopɔn no wɔ?
Mede m’ani bɛhwɛ no,
afei wɔbɛtiatia ne so
sɛ mmorɔno so dɔteɛ.
11Ɛda a wɔbɛto wo fasuo no reba;
ɛda no so na w’ahyeɛ bɛkɔ akyirikyirie.
12Ɛda no na wɔbɛfiri
Asiria ne Misraim nkuro mu aba wo nkyɛn,
na wɔbɛfiri Misraim akɔsi asuo no ano,
afiri po akɔsi po, afiri bepɔ no akɔsi bepɔ aba.
13Na asase no bɛdane amamfo,
ɛsofoɔ no nti,
wɔn nneyɛɛ so aba no nti.
14 # Mika 5.4; Num 23.9 Fa wo poma yɛne wo man,
w’agyapadeɛ nnwan
a wɔn nko ara te kwaeɛm,
Karmel atifi no.
Ma wɔnnidi Basan ne Gilead
sɛ tete nna no mu.
15Mɛma wɔahunu anwanwadeɛ
sɛ nna a wɔfirii Misraim asase so baeɛ no.
16 # Hiob 21.5 Amanaman bɛhunu, na wɔn ani awuwu wɔn mmaninneɛ nyinaa ho;
wɔde wɔn nsa bɛtuatua wɔn ano,
na wɔn aso nso bɛsisi.
17 # Yes 49.23 Wɔbɛtafere mfuturo sɛ ɔwɔ,
sɛ mmoa a wɔtwe wɔn ho fam,
wɔde ahopopoɔ bɛfiri wɔn huntabea aba;
wɔde suro bɛbɛn AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔasuro w’anim.
Nyankopɔn adom mu ahotosoɔ
18 # Dwom 103.3, 8-13 Hwan na ɔte sɛ wo; Onyankopɔn a wode amumuyɛ kyɛ
na wosiane mmarato ho
ma w’agyapadeɛ nkaeɛ no?
Worensɔ w’abufuo mu daa,
na adɔeɛ mmom na wopɛ;
19yɛn ho na wobɛsane ama ne yam ahyehye wo,
wobɛpepa yɛn amumuyɛ.
Na wobɛto wɔn bɔne nyinaa
agu ɛpo bunu mu.
20 # Gye 22.16-18; 28.13-15; Luk 1.73 Fa nokorɛ kyerɛ Yakob,
yi adɔeɛ kyerɛ Abraham,
sɛdeɛ wokaa yɛn agyanom ntam
firi tete nteredee nna mu no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
